statement_fidelity: lem_tube_e0 has no CBG parameters. Its hypotheses are GH and IsE0CauchyMaximal (proved equal to Dev.IsETTMaximal) for a T2, connected, second-countable 𝔼₀-manifold, which is DEC-66 plus DEC-116 (b). For p ∈ S0 M it gives ∃ R U, IsSpearNbhd p R U. That is the paper's 'for any BTZ line Δ and any p ∈ Δ, a spear neighbourhood of vertex p', with the vertex free as DEC-116 (c) rules. No Cauchy surface is assumed. IsSpearNbhd is not trivialising (ψ is an injective 𝔼₀-morphism on an open W ⊇ spear, U = ψ(spear)). isSpearNbhd_model shows it can be inhabited. lem_add_BTZ_param_line_e0 takes the paper's hypotheses: GH, Σ Cauchy, Δ with a spear neighbourhood of some vertex q, p in Δ ∩ I⁻(Σ). It covers both cases ('q in the past of p' and DEC-108's 'q in the future of p'). It concludes a C⁰ τ_Σ, not a smooth one; the row is correctly partial and unmarked, with the counterexample Σ = {τ = |Re z|/4} given at paper level and the question to the master. The six new declarations add only GH where they need it (isClosed_spearImage, frontier_spearImage, frontier_eq, mem_nhds_of_line) and no other hypotheses. interior_spearImage needs no global hypothesis. No hypothesis I tried is vacuous: all of them are met by 𝔼₀ itself, and the line hypotheses of mem_nhds_of_line by E0GlobalBTZ.line.
summary: Builds clean with warnings as errors, 0 real sorry, axioms standard; the strict GX library is up to date; no name clashes; REPORT names all resolve and the duplicates are gone. Round 1's major is fixed in substance: Def 2.1's boundary assertion is now proved in M (GH) by a correct closedness argument. But the row stays marked and closed with an unruled added hypothesis (GH), and the boundary sentence is open for non-GH 𝔼₀-manifolds. That violates kb/0006 / DEC-27, so it is one major.
